# authwise_realm (Resource)

A realm: a population of users with its own providers, factors and authentication policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tenant-scoped: tenant_id comes from the provider default unless set here.
resource "authwise_realm" "employees" {
  display_name = "Employees"
  config       = jsonencode({ defaultLocale = "en" })

  labels = {
    team = "platform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config` (String) `config` as the protojson encoding of RealmConfig.
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `realm_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_realm.example tenants/t-01/realms/r-01
```
